scope: Intersection of E-IX US baseline and fixed Kuromis US 02 / Sparkcloud US 02. Singapore and the earlier Kuromis fallback-group comparison are excluded. Per-URL expected-status-aware histories confirm each round. These are short-window observations at different times; candidates were initially screened through E-IX, not an unbiased airport ranking or long-term uptime guarantee. The 470-site production subset retains the lowest worst observed delay across nine probes; ties use within-run delay range, then median delay, then URL. This ranks observed latency, not long-term reliability.

selectionPolicy.latencyValue: For each probe, use max(delayMs, historyDelayMs). Variation is the largest within-run range, not the difference between airports.
selectionPolicy.outputOrder: Preserve original manifest order and existing site IDs.
